---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new capability, skill, workflow, or adapter
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

What can't you do today, or what's harder than it should be?

## Proposed solution

What you'd like. If it's a skill, workflow, tracker adapter, or runtime driver,
say which — those often need no engine change at all.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you weighed and why you set them aside.

## Does this need an engine change?

The engine is deliberately small and holds no skill names. If the feature can live
in a workflow file, a skill, or an adapter, note that here.
